<div class="wrap">
<h1>Deferred revenue</h1>
<p class="sub">ASC 606 contract liability from the live backlog XBRL tape. Rising deferred revenue is cash collected before revenue is recognized. Blank is untagged, not zero. Click headers to sort.</p>
<input id="q" placeholder="filter ticker / sector" autocomplete="off">
<div id="board">Loading /data/backlog.json</div>
<div class="foot"><b>Built for:</b> seeing whether customers have prepaid more work than the income statement has recognized.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/backlog.json fields deferred_rev, deferred_asof, deferred_qoq, deferred_yoy, deferred_accelerating, rev_yoy, cik.<br>
<b>Not:</b> cRPO, ARR, or an 8-K guide. Billings uses this same deferred change only when TTM is also dated.</div>
</div>
<script>
function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];});}
function bn(v){if(v==null||!isFinite(Number(v)))return "";v=Number(v);var a=Math.abs(v);if(a>=1e12)return (v/1e12).toFixed(2)+"T";if(a>=1e9)return (v/1e9).toFixed(2)+"B";if(a>=1e6)return (v/1e6).toFixed(1)+"M";return v.toFixed(0);}
function pct(v){if(v==null||!isFinite(Number(v)))return "";return (Number(v)>0?"+":"")+Number(v).toFixed(1)+"%";}
function cls(v){return v==null?"":(Number(v)>0?"pos":Number(v)<0?"neg":"");}
function cmp(a,b,k,dir){var av=a[k],bv=b[k];if(av==null&&bv==null)return String(a.ticker||"").localeCompare(String(b.ticker||""));if(av==null)return 1;if(bv==null)return -1;if(typeof av==="number"||typeof bv==="number"){av=Number(av);bv=Number(bv);if(!isFinite(av))return 1;if(!isFinite(bv))return -1;return (av-bv)*dir;}return String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))*dir;}
(async function(){
  var d=null,SORT="deferred_yoy",DIR=-1;
  try{var r=await fetch("/data/backlog.json?t="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"});if(r.ok)d=await r.json();}catch(e){}
  var rows=Object.keys((d&&d.by_ticker)||{}).map(function(k){return d.by_ticker[k];});
  var cols=[["ticker","Ticker","l"],["sector","Sector","l"],["deferred_rev","Deferred $",""],["deferred_yoy","Def YoY",""],["deferred_qoq","Def QoQ",""],["rev_yoy","Rev YoY",""],["deferred_asof","As of","l"]];
  function paint(){
    var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
    var list=rows.filter(function(x){return !q||(String(x.ticker||"")+" "+String(x.sector||"")).toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;}).sort(function(a,b){return cmp(a,b,SORT,DIR);});
    var h="<table><thead><tr>";
    cols.forEach(function(c){h+="<th class='"+(c[2]||"")+(SORT===c[0]?" on":"")+"' data-k="+c[0]+">"+c[1]+(SORT===c[0]?(DIR>0?" \u2191":" \u2193"):"")+"</th>";});
    h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
    list.forEach(function(x){
      h+="<tr><td class=l><a href=/ticker.html?symbol="+encodeURIComponent(x.ticker)+" style=color:#fff>"+esc(x.ticker)+"</a>"+(x.deferred_accelerating?" \u00b7 accel":"")+"</td>";
      h+="<td class=l>"+esc(x.sector||"")+"</td><td>"+esc(bn(x.deferred_rev))+"</td>";
      h+="<td class="+cls(x.deferred_yoy)+">"+esc(pct(x.deferred_yoy))+"</td>";
      h+="<td class="+cls(x.deferred_qoq)+">"+esc(pct(x.deferred_qoq))+"</td>";
      h+="<td class="+cls(x.rev_yoy)+">"+esc(pct(x.rev_yoy))+"</td>";
      h+="<td class=l>"+esc(x.deferred_asof||"")+"</td></tr>";
    });
    document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table><p class=sub>"+list.length+" names. Generated "+esc((d&&d.generated_at)||"")+".</p>";
    document.querySelectorAll("#board th[data-k]").forEach(function(th){th.onclick=function(){if(SORT===th.dataset.k)DIR=-DIR;else{SORT=th.dataset.k;DIR=th.dataset.k==="ticker"||th.dataset.k==="sector"||th.dataset.k==="deferred_asof"?1:-1;}paint();};});
  }
  if(!rows.length){document.getElementById("board").textContent="backlog.json missing.";return;}
  document.getElementById("q").oninput=paint;paint();
})();
</script>
